name: SOGAZ
verdict: Nobody controls SOGAZ; state-controlled VTB holds 10% and a board seat (2018 merger). On the chest of FC Baltika's shirt in 2026-27.
note: Rating note: per SOGAZ's January 2020 shareholder disclosure (as relayed by The Bell and Forbes), the largest shareholder is the Kovalchuk family (32.3% via Aquilla); state-controlled VTB took 10% plus a board seat in the 2018 merger, and Gazprom-group entities held 21.19%. The disclosure is stale (January 2020) — a more recent structure was not found in open sources. Propose concern (a state with a documented record holds 5%+ and a board seat through VTB, without control); a maintainer may prefer to hold it unrated given the age of the disclosure. No company-level human-rights finding found. League-partner deal for KHL kept in data/deals/khl-sogaz.json.
